fixture_kind: Literal, hand-authored synthetic summaries; no simulation, sampling or numerical diagnostics were run to create these values

model_context.parameter_scope: Flat scalar v, a, z and t; no regressions or lapse mixture

files.diagnostics.json: Joint-model convergence and LOO-status schema consumed by bayesian-workflow/scripts/check_diagnostics.py
files.psense.json: Parameter-to-fields sensitivity schema; the source density arrays are not supplied
files.domain_checks.csv: Observed statistics and central 94% intervals of literal replicated statistics; RT quantiles are conditional on response

interval_meaning: lower_94 and upper_94 summarize replicated statistics, not parameter HDIs; replicates_with_quantity omits absent-choice replicates only for conditional RT quantiles
